title: refactor(plugin-auth): derive the SCIM connection-id cap from SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9Hju7DThD7eoLKoJU9hnHj)_

Fixes #31033

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** SCIM 凭证签发接口对 `connectionId` 的长度上限（246）原来把 `svc:scim:` 前缀再手写了一遍来计算，现在改为读取已导出的常量 `SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX` 的长度；本卡 changeset 另补一段 Exported，说明随 SCIM 凭证接口新增的两个公开 `AuthManager` 方法。
- **为什么改：** 审计里 SCIM 连接的操作者标签就是用这个常量拼出来的；如果以后前缀改了而上限没跟着改，过长的连接 id 会让该连接每次请求的审计写入失败。现在两者只有一个来源。
- **风险与回滚：** 行为不变（上限仍是 246，超长仍答 400 INVALID_REQUEST），只是 plugin-auth 的一处常量来源加一份 patch changeset；回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-admin.ts` 的 `MAX_SCIM_CONNECTION_ID`；`.changeset/31033-scim-connection-id-cap-from-prefix.md`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/scim-connection-admin.test.ts`，预期 10 个用例全绿（含 246 可签发、247 被拒）。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-admin.ts`: `MAX_SCIM_CONNECTION_ID` is now `MAX_TEXT - SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX.length` instead of `MAX_TEXT - 'svc:scim:'.length`, importing the constant from `scim-connection-service.ts` (already imported from there). The doc comment says why. Value unchanged: 246.
- `.changeset/31033-scim-connection-id-cap-from-prefix.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-auth`. It also carries the card's optional item: an Exported paragraph naming the two public `AuthManager` methods behind the SCIM credential routes (`isScimWired()`, `mintScimConnectionCredential(engine, input)`), which the pending #30958 release note does not name. That note itself is untouched (byte-identical to `main`).

## Tests

- No test edited: the existing pin in `scim-connection-admin.test.ts` (246 accepted, 247 refused, `9 + 246 === 255`) holds unchanged.
- One-shot reverse proof that the cap now follows the constant (not kept as a test): with `SCIM_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_PREFIX` mutated to a 10-character `svc:scimx:` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the pin turns red: the 246-character mint answers `400` with "at most 245 characters". Restored; blob hash equals HEAD (`9557afe1`), `git status` clean, file rerun 10/10 green.

## Acceptance notes

- None.
